summary: We are not going to do a 5-person Ui/UX test. Setup Slice 80 like a release readiness slice: update project, user-facing, and developer documentation. Setup and test CI (local is okay for now). Establish packaging and distribution methods (eventually to registries). Slice 90 should be the slice that performs the release - it will be local for 0.2.0, and will not deploy to registries, but to a dist/ directory for binaries (.gitignored).
